assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need to evaluate for potential arrhythmias contributing to hemodynamic instability
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is indicated
CPT code 93247 represents long-term continuous ECG monitoring
The monitoring is intended to correlate clinical events with cardiac rhythm disturbances
